evidence.observation: Required exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; growth atmosphere cannot be verified.
Tube pressure was 2.897 Torr during growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.175 Torr despite approximately constant temperature and argon flow; the cause and acceptable pressure range are not established.
Temperature is 750.3 °C against 750 °C setpoint and Ar is 99.2 sccm against 100 sccm; O2 remains unavailable.
